capabilities: Show due flashcards in a frameless always-on-top popup at a configurable interval
Reveal answers and rate cards (Again/Hard/Good/Easy) through Spaced Repetition's review pipeline
Filter decks and mix in new cards with daily limits, do-not-disturb windows, pausing and snoozing
Mirror the popup to a local web page for OBS browser sources or screen sharing
Expose CLI commands so external tools can check whether editing a note would disturb an open card
extras: Desktop-only (uses an Electron window; no mobile). Depends on internals of the Spaced Repetition plugin, so updates to that plugin can disable popup reviews; tested with v1.15.4. Documents a known Spaced Repetition 1.15.4 bug affecting the Start of day setting. Japanese README available.
intentEvidence: Companion plugin for the Spaced Repetition plugin.
problem: Reviewing flashcards requires opening Obsidian and its review modal, so reviews get skipped when the app is not in the foreground; this plugin reviews due cards from a small popup while Obsidian stays minimized.
summary: Always-on-top desktop popup that shows due Spaced Repetition flashcards at set intervals and saves ratings through the Spaced Repetition plugin.
